question: What is the primary focus of nursing unit management compared to direct clinical nursing?

options.D: Collective ward productivity and overall operations

explanation: Unit management expands beyond single-patient care to oversee the broader operational needs, safety, and productivity of an entire healthcare unit. [learn more](GST321_U6_T2#GST321_U6_T2_h1)

question: Why must a nurse manager possess both clinical competence and administrative skills?

options.A: To eliminate all financial expenses within the hospital department
options.B: To completely replace the need for attending physicians on the ward
options.C: To bridge communication between hospital executives and bedside clinicians
options.D: To perform every direct patient procedure personally on each shift

explanation: A manager translates high-level institutional goals into practical bedside realities while representing frontline staff needs to executive leadership. [learn more](GST321_U6_T2#GST321_U6_T2_h1)

question: Which leadership style is most effective for fostering long-term staff engagement and professional growth in a ward?
explanation: Transformational leaders inspire and motivate staff by encouraging innovation, personal growth, and a shared vision for quality care. [learn more](GST321_U6_T2#GST321_U6_T2_h2)

question: When would an autocratic leadership approach be most appropriate in a nursing unit?

options.A: During sudden clinical emergencies or crises
options.B: When planning a voluntary team-building exercise
options.C: When designing a new continuous professional development schedule
options.D: During an annual staff satisfaction survey review

explanation: Rapid, directive decision-making is essential when immediate, coordinated action is required to save lives during a crisis. [learn more](GST321_U6_T2#GST321_U6_T2_h2)

question: What is the primary factor a nurse manager must consider when creating a safe duty roster?

options.A: Strict adherence to straight rotating day shifts
options.B: Patient acuity and staff competency mix
options.C: Personal social friendships among staff members
options.D: The personal vehicle availability of each nurse

explanation: Safe staffing requires matching the severity of patient illnesses with the appropriate skill levels and numbers of available nurses. [learn more](GST321_U6_T2#GST321_U6_T2_h3)

question: A nurse manager who consistently addresses interpersonal staff conflicts and mentors junior nurses is primarily fulfilling which role?
explanation: Supporting staff development, resolving workplace disputes, and organizing personnel schedules fall directly under human resource management. [learn more](GST321_U6_T2#GST321_U6_T2_h3)

question: What is the primary purpose of reviewing incident reports in a quality assurance framework?

options.A: To document legal evidence for external police investigations
options.B: To uncover systemic workflow failures and prevent recurrence
options.C: To publicly shame negligent practitioners during handover
options.D: To immediately terminate the employment of the involved staff

explanation: Modern healthcare safety frameworks focus on a non-punitive culture that analyzes root system causes rather than blaming individuals. [learn more](GST321_U6_T2#GST321_U6_T2_h4)

question: Which indicator is most directly monitored by a unit manager to assess clinical quality assurance?

options.B: The total number of hospital parking spaces

explanation: Infection rates directly reflect the quality of aseptic technique, environmental cleaning, and direct clinical care provided on the unit. [learn more](GST321_U6_T2#GST321_U6_T2_h4)

question: What is a negative consequence of ordering excessive medical consumable inventory for a ward?

options.A: Ties up capital and risks product expiration
options.B: Eliminates all future equipment maintenance needs
options.C: Automatically increases overall daily patient census

explanation: Over-ordering wastes financial resources and leads to expired stock that must be discarded, violating principles of good budgetary control. [learn more](GST321_U6_T2#GST321_U6_T2_h5)

question: How does effective budgetary control impact direct patient care on a nursing unit?

options.A: It allows the unit to operate completely independently of hospital finance
options.B: It removes the need for nurses to document clinical procedures
options.C: It guarantees that patients receive free medications during admission
options.D: It ensures necessary supplies are available without wasting financial resources

explanation: Prudent financial management maintains a steady supply chain of essential medical items while keeping healthcare affordable and sustainable. [learn more](GST321_U6_T2#GST321_U6_T2_h5)

question: Which factor contributes directly to psychological safety within a healthcare unit?

options.A: Limiting interprofessional communication to written memos
options.B: Staff feeling empowered to report near-misses without fear
options.C: Strict enforcement of mandatory overtime for all nurses
options.D: Elimination of all patient family visits during admission

explanation: Psychological safety thrives in environments where healthcare workers can openly discuss errors and near-misses to improve system safety. [learn more](GST321_U6_T2#GST321_U6_T2_h6)

question: A patient recovery rate is most directly influenced by which environmental feature managed by the nurse?

options.A: The architectural design of the hospital exterior facade
options.B: Frequent rotation of administrative accounting personnel
options.C: Proper ventilation, lighting, and infection control practices
options.D: The proximity of the hospital to local commercial markets

explanation: Clean physical surroundings and strict infection prevention directly reduce complications and promote physiological healing. [learn more](GST321_U6_T2#GST321_U6_T2_h6)

question: What is the primary benefit of utilizing structured shift handovers and multidisciplinary rounds?

options.A: Replaces the need for comprehensive patient health records
options.B: Decreases the total length of the hospital working day
options.C: Prevents fragmentation of care and reduces medication errors
options.D: Ensures only physicians make decisions regarding patient discharge

explanation: Structured communication bridges gaps between shifts and disciplines, ensuring critical patient data is accurately shared. [learn more](GST321_U6_T2#GST321_U6_T2_h7)

question: Which action best demonstrates effective interprofessional collaboration on a busy hospital ward?

options.A: Relying solely on verbal instructions passed through informal channels
options.B: Each clinical department working in strict isolation without sharing notes
options.C: Nurses, pharmacists, and physicians conducting joint patient care rounds
options.D: Delegating all inter-departmental communication strictly to junior clerks

explanation: Joint rounds allow multiple disciplines to align treatment goals and address patient needs collaboratively in real-time. [learn more](GST321_U6_T2#GST321_U6_T2_h7)

question: What is a major systemic challenge frequently managed by nurse leaders in Nigerian healthcare facilities?

options.A: High patient-to-nurse ratios and infrastructural deficits
options.B: Zero absenteeism across all clinical departments
options.C: Strictly enforced limits preventing staff overtime work
options.D: An excessive surplus of advanced medical technology

explanation: Nigerian units often face heavy workloads due to staff shortages and intermittent power or water supplies, requiring strong resilience. [learn more](GST321_U6_T2#GST321_U6_T2_h8)

question: Which of the following is NOT a typical strategy used by nurse managers to cope with local resource constraints in Nigerian wards?

options.A: Ignoring safety standards to speed up patient turnover
options.B: Persistent advocacy for basic facility infrastructural upgrades
options.C: Creative contingency planning for power and water outages
options.D: Resource improvisation without compromising patient safety

explanation: Good managers never compromise core patient safety standards, even when improvising around difficult infrastructural challenges. [learn more](GST321_U6_T2#GST321_U6_T2_h8)
